title: Show 'Admin' badge next to admin names in order notes
description: As a customer I want to see an 'Admin' badge next to messages written by our admins in the order notes so that I know who is replying. This only changes how existing notes are displayed; no permissions or data change.
acceptance_criteria: Notes written by admins show an 'Admin' badge next to the author name
Notes written by customers show no badge
The badge is visible on desktop and mobile layouts
_note: Display-only change that contains the word 'admin'. rules.py will wrongly force Manual Review (false positive). Tests whether the keyword rules are too broad.
